tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List the work and business categories that currently have listings on RozgarSewa, with a count for each.

kind.description: Which listings to summarise: workers, businesses, or all (default).

tools.name: search_workers
tools.title: Search workers
tools.description: Search RozgarSewa workers (plumbers, electricians, carpenters, etc.) by category, village, or name. Returns public listing details only.

category.description: Work category, e.g. Plumber, Electrician, Painter.

village.description: Village or town name to filter by.

name.description: Partial worker name to search for.

limit.description: Maximum number of workers to return (default 20, max 50).

tools.name: get_worker
tools.title: Get worker profile
tools.description: Get the full public profile of one RozgarSewa worker by id, including experience, pricing, availability, ratings and reviews.

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.title: Search local businesses
tools.description: Search public RozgarSewa local business listings (shops, construction, agriculture, vehicle and home services) by category or village.

category.description: Business category to filter by, e.g. Shop, Construction.

village.description: Village or town name to filter by.

limit.description: Maximum number of businesses to return (default 20, max 50).

tools.name: search_digital_services
tools.title: Search digital service centres
tools.description: Search public RozgarSewa digital service listings (online forms, printing, Aadhaar/PAN work) by service type or village.

service_type.description: Service type to filter by, e.g. Printing, Online Form.

village.description: Village or town name to filter by.

limit.description: Maximum number of listings to return (default 20, max 50).

tools.name: search_coaching_centres
tools.title: Search coaching centres
tools.description: Search public RozgarSewa education and coaching listings by course type or village, including fees and timings.

course_type.description: Course type to filter by, e.g. Computer, Maths, Spoken English.

village.description: Village or town name to filter by.

limit.description: Maximum number of listings to return (default 20, max 50).
